description:
Instrument the TUI render hot path so we can observe — with numbers — what happens to keyboard latency while a streaming response is being rendered. All events register with `OctoPi.Tracer` and flow to the existing `FileBackend` log.

## Events

| Event | Type | Metadata |
|---|---|---|
| `[:octo_pi_tui, :interactive, :handle_info, :start \| :stop]` | `:telemetry.span` | `%{kind: :hid_event \| :octo_pi_agent_event \| :render_tick \| ..., mailbox_len_before}` |
| `[:octo_pi_tui, :transcript, :render, :start \| :stop]` | span | `%{streaming?, msg_count, line_count}` |
| `[:octo_pi_tui, :markdown, :render, :start \| :stop]` | span | `%{text_bytes, width, line_count, streaming?, msg_id}` |
| `[:octo_pi_tui, :key, :latency]` | execute | `%{duration_us}` (arrival in `Terminal` narrowcast → handled in `Interactive`), metadata `%{key, mailbox_len_at_arrival}` |
| `[:octo_pi_tui, :interactive, :mailbox]` | execute | `%{message_queue_len}` sampled at `handle_info` entry |

## Wiring

- `:telemetry.span/3` for duration events (start/stop pair, exception-safe).
- `key.latency` arrival timestamp captured at `Terminal` narrowcast, not at `Interactive` `handle_info` — we want the queueing delay included.
- `mailbox_len_before` from `Process.info(self(), :message_queue_len)` at `handle_info` entry.
- `streaming?` metadata is load-bearing; without it we can't separate the per-chunk hot path from the final render.

## Tracer registration

In `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/application.ex`:
- Extend `:tui_render` with `[:octo_pi_tui, :transcript, :render, ...]` and `[:octo_pi_tui, :markdown, :render, ...]`.
- Add `:tui_interactive` group at `:debug` for `handle_info` spans, mailbox samples, and `key.latency`.

## Acceptance

- All events fire during a streaming run; tracer file output for one streaming turn can be filtered by event name.
- Idle overhead is sub-millisecond per `handle_info`.
title: Add render-path telemetry to observe streaming keyboard latency
